_about: Paintings for the tops of windows (the user, 2026-11-13: more art from LocalSpawn, 'a picture tab at the top' of the workshop and the others; the portal's window with the portal as its motif). Tools/LocalSpawn/generate_ui_art.py windows -> WindowArt/<key>.png; AgentScripts/BuildUIArt.cs (Windows) copies them to Resources/WindowArt, where HearthKit.Banner finds them by key. Banners are wide (1536x512) and shown as a band across a window's top, so what matters is in the middle third, left to right. Station banners are keyed by CraftingStationType. Warm firelit interiors, painterly, a dark Nordic folktale.

Portal.prompt: A tall ancient stone archway carved all over with interlaced Norse knotwork and runes stands at the end of a mossy flagstone path in a misty old forest at dusk, a faint warm amber glow living in its carvings and a cold blue shimmer of mist inside the arch, a lone cloaked traveller with a burning torch walks towards it, gnarled pines and ferns, painterly dark fantasy illustration, rich colour, no text.
